definitions.explanation: The act of passing through a place without stopping, or successfully going through a process.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{関東|かんとう}{地方|ちほう}を{通過|つうか}した。
examples.english: The typhoon passed through the Kanto region.

examples.japanese: この{電車|でんしゃ}は{次|つぎ}の{駅|えき}を{通過|つうか}します。
examples.english: This train will pass through the next station without stopping.

examples.japanese: {法案|ほうあん}が{国会|こっかい}を{通過|つうか}した。
examples.english: The bill passed through the parliament.

examples.japanese: {審査|しんさ}を{通過|つうか}して{安心|あんしん}した。
examples.english: I felt relieved after passing the screening.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}この{駅|えき}を{通過|つうか}する{電車|でんしゃ}の{音|おと}で{目|め}が{覚|さ}める。
examples.english: Every morning I wake up to the sound of trains passing through this station.

notes:
{通過|つうか} means to pass through a place without stopping, or to successfully clear a process or review. It takes the particle を.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive) with する
- Pattern: 〜を{通過|つうか}する

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駅|えき}を{通過|つうか}する: to pass through a station (without stopping)
- {審査|しんさ}を{通過|つうか}する: to pass screening/review
- {税関|ぜいかん}を{通過|つうか}する: to pass through customs
- {国会|こっかい}を{通過|つうか}する: to pass through parliament (of a bill)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {通過|つうか}{点|てん}: passing point, waypoint
- {通過|つうか}{駅|えき}: station that a train passes through without stopping

HOMOPHONE:
{通貨|つうか} (currency) has the same reading but a completely different meaning. Context usually makes the distinction clear.
